title: UAE completes Arab world’s first solo space probe – and sets course for an asteroid
title_zh: 阿联酋完成阿拉伯世界首枚独行太空探测器任务——并前往小行星带
abstract: Device will be launched on a craft built jointly by the United Arab Emirates and the United States. Some researchers say it could be the last mission constructed with outside help.
abstract_zh: 该装置将由阿联酋和美国共同建造的航天器发射。部分研究人员表示，这可能是最后一次获得外部协助的任务。
